title: USB Implementers Forum
extract: USB Implementers Forum, Inc. (USB-IF) is a nonprofit organization created to promote and maintain USB, a set of specifications and transmission procedures for a type of cable connection that has since become used widely for electronic equipment. Its main activities are currently the promotion and marketing of USB4, USB 3.2, USB Power Delivery, USB Type-C, and the maintenance of standards and specifications for the related devices, as well as a compliance program.
